title: The sprint owns paths in sc-jev, sc-jev-backends and sc-decision-schema, but its `requirements` list omits ids that apply to them
description: The sprint owns paths in sc-jev, sc-jev-backends and sc-decision-schema, but its `requirements` list omits ids that apply to them. From the crate files: REQ-SAG-0110 (sc-jev); REQ-SAG-0502, 0503, 0504 and 0505 (sc-jev-backends; validate.rs cites the REQ-SAG-0502 byte cap and its retry tests sit in the same crate); REQ-SAG-0144, 0145 and 0146 (sc-decision-schema). The repo-level NFRs are missing too: NFR-SAG-0001 (the boundary row already runs test_error_response_stderr_golden), NFR-SAG-0002 (secrets; D9 and ADR-SAG-0020), NFR-SAG-0003 and NFR-SAG-0004. Each one is binding.
